# VJ Fader — James Cui

> VJ Fader (James Cui) is a Berlin-based motion designer, stage designer and VFX artist with 15+ years of work in music visuals: audio-reactive real-time VFX in Unreal Engine Niagara, AI video (Runway, Luma, ComfyUI), projection mapping and festival stage design.

- Website: https://vjfader.com/
- Location: Berlin, Germany
- Also known as: VJ Fader, Fader, Wen Cui

## Pages

- [Home](https://vjfader.com/): overview, selected work, about, awards and contact
- [VFX Music Visualization](https://vjfader.com/vfx/): real-time, audio-reactive VFX, Unreal Niagara, AI video workflows
- [Stage Design](https://vjfader.com/stage-design/): festival and live stage design, video mapping, gallery

## Awards

- Janus Award – Best Sonic Experience, Fulldome Festival Jena (2026)
- App Art Award, ZKM Karlsruhe (2015)

## Experience highlights

- Freelance motion and music visualization artist, Berlin (2022–present): AI video-to-video restyling of real-time Unreal animations, an AI short film, AI-driven projection mapping
- Sensorium (2023–2024) and TLM Partners (2021–2022): audio-reactive VFX for VR DJ experiences in Unreal Niagara
- Popcore and StarBerry Games (2019–2022): motion design and video ads for mobile games
- INTRO Electronic Music Festival, Beijing (2011–2018): stage design from concept to build
- Stage design and video mapping for Fuji Rock, Backwoods, Invasion, Nuit Blanche Paris and Mapping Festival Geneva
- Workshops taught: Unity for Visual Artists (Berlin, LA, Cape Town, London), video mapping (LA, San Diego)

## Tools

Runway, Luma, ComfyUI, Midjourney, Unreal Engine (Niagara), Unity, Blender, After Effects, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve
